definitions.explanation: Matters relating to the military, armed forces, warfare, or defense. Frequently used as a prefix modifying other nouns.

examples.japanese: {軍事|ぐんじ}{力|りょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{強化|きょうか}する→強化する：25344_kyoukasuru⟧。
⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{軍事|ぐんじ}⟦{衝突|しょうとつ}→衝突：03235_shoutotsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: Military conflicts continue in that region.

examples.japanese: ⟦{両国|りょうこく}→両国：10010_ryoukoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{軍事|ぐんじ}⟦{同盟|どうめい}→同盟：05321_doumei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{結|むす}び→結ぶ：02308_musubu⟧、⟦{安全|あんぜん}{保障|ほしょう}→安全保障：05788_anzenhoshou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{協力|きょうりょく}している→協力する：25370_kyouryokusuru⟧。
examples.english: The two countries formed a military alliance and cooperate on security.

notes:
{軍事|ぐんじ} is most commonly used as a modifier preceding other nouns, functioning like an adjective.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {軍事|ぐんじ}{力|りょく} (military power)
- {軍事|ぐんじ}⟦{基地|きち}→基地：03982_kichi⟧ (military base)
- {軍事|ぐんじ}⟦{同盟|どうめい}→同盟：05321_doumei⟧ (military alliance)
- {軍事|ぐんじ}⟦{作戦|さくせん}→作戦：09673_sakusen⟧ (military operation)
- {軍事|ぐんじ}{費|ひ} (military expenditure)
- {軍事|ぐんじ}⟦{政権|せいけん}→政権：12883_seiken⟧ (military regime)
- {軍事|ぐんじ}⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧ (military technology)

Distinct from ⟦{軍|ぐん}→軍：02677_gun⟧ (army, military force) which refers to the armed forces themselves. {軍事|ぐんじ} is more abstract, referring to military matters, policy, or affairs as a category.
